scenarios.name: weekday_sales_ramp
scenarios.note: Thursday: weekday nights of every room, the pace step with the sales ramp, the last-minute market floor of the owner's plan from D7 to D0 and the weekend nights of the ladder at the edge.

scenarios.name: weekend_owner_plan
scenarios.note: Weekend nights priced by the owner's ladder (Friday and Saturday), with the relations of the ladder night.

scenarios.name: holiday_period
scenarios.note: The holiday of 19-21 Nov priced by the ladder and the holiday floors, with the nights around it.

scenarios.name: sold_out_and_reopened
scenarios.note: Sold-out nights get the protection floor (the locked rule in force is deleted first); nights that were sold out and reopened leave the locked rule.

scenarios.name: light_run_filter
scenarios.note: Light run: only the nights of the filter take a pace step or a protection; the others feed the relations.

scenarios.name: orphan_nights
scenarios.note: Sold-out nights next to free nights, all under locked rules: the sold-out nights' rules are deleted first and written again with their stay; the free nights keep their rules and get their own items. No rule of a free night is rewritten here, so these inputs produce no orphan claim.

scenarios.name: occupancy_switch_80
scenarios.note: With 80% of the tub suites of the second property sold, the room without a tub goes to the market.

scenarios.name: owner_orders_by_date
scenarios.note: Owner orders by date: a fixed price, a floor order and a market target order without a sales ramp.

scenarios.name: frozen_nights
scenarios.note: Nights frozen by a manual change of the owner and nights blocked in the PMS stay as they are.

scenarios.name: band_released_by_order
scenarios.note: A fixed-price order that releases the discount band: the room under the band's lower edge is a warning.

scenarios.name: range_orders_d1
scenarios.note: Real inputs of a full run (calendars, rules, ledger and the owner's range orders with the sales ramp, fallback floors and descent steps); the occupancy switch item that changes nothing is dropped (L5).

scenarios.name: range_orders_d0
scenarios.note: Real inputs of the next day's full run: the sales ramp of the range orders from D0, a protection that writes the floor in force again on D0 (L6) and the occupancy switch without effect (L5).

scenarios.name: small_rooms
scenarios.note: Rooms of one and two units read with their property's tub suites, and the single room above the others.
